test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT are optional for first-year applicants; scores on an official high-school transcript are accepted. The international steps page lists college-prep coursework, U.S.-equivalent GPA and a personal statement as the basis for first-year admission.

requirements.notes: Undergraduate application fee is $60. First-year applicants write a personal statement (the Common App essay satisfies it); minimum coursework is 4 English, 3 social studies, 3 math, 3 lab science and 2 foreign language or fine arts, and students lacking some units may be admitted conditionally. Applicants with non-U.S. schooling need a credential evaluation (waived for IB, CIS, U.S. State Dept-assisted and U.S.-accredited schools). Decisions are rolling (biweekly).

deadlines.label: International (F-1) application deadline, fall term (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The page prints 'Fall Term Deadline: May 15th' and 'Spring Term Deadline: Nov 15th' without a year; treated as fall 2027. Applications should arrive at least 3 months before the intended start; some programs have earlier deadlines.

deadlines.label: Priority / early action date (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: From CDS C14 and C22 (Dec. 1, rolling notification), not repeated on the admissions pages; treated as the date for fall 2027 entry.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Citizens of a list of English-speaking countries (for example Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, Singapore, South Africa, UK) are waived automatically. Petition-based exemptions include 3+ years of U.S. or DoD high school, or 60 college credits in a listed country. Scores must be under 2 years old. Alternatives to a test: SAT verbal 570, ACT English 24, AP English 4+, IB English A 5+, ELS Level 112, or an English language program at CEFR B2. UIS Global partnership students are handled separately.

english.notes: UIS code 1787. TOEFL Essentials (8.0) also accepted. Communication BA needs 95.
Listed as 'New TOEFL (effective January 2026)', undergraduate minimum 4.0.
B2 First is the undergraduate minimum; the page gives no numeric score.

aid.notes: UIS says financial assistance for international students is limited. First-year, international and transfer applicants are automatically reviewed for merit scholarships (Star Scholar Award $3,000-$7,000/yr by unweighted GPA on the 2025-26 schedule, renewable; Capital Scholars Honors up to $8,000/yr), and donor-funded scholarships (apply early Nov to mid-Feb) are open to international students. The Out-of-State Scholarship is not available to international or UIS Global students. CDS H6: 52 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $13,083.
